# `cube::AbilityId`

[Game reference](../README.md) › [combat](../combat.md) › `cube::AbilityId`

- **Kind:** enum, 1-byte values
- **Status:** verified (source: kyubu)
- **C:** `cube_AbilityId` in `cubeworld/types.h`
- **Lua:** `cubeworld.enums["cube::AbilityId"]`
- **Evidence:** `xref:cube::Creature::modeDuration`, `xref:cube::World::abilityDispatchSite`, `probe:ability-force`, `cuwo:cuwo/strings.py`
- **Confirmed by:** [ability-force](../probes.md#ability-force)

the value of cube::CreatureData.current_mode; 0 to 110 (modeDuration covers 0 to 105, the dispatch in cube::World::update up to 110), named from the cast bar and the skill tooltips; the MODE_<id> names are placeholders until the game's use of the id is known
